definitions.explanation: The degree to which an optical device enlarges an image. Expressed as a multiple (e.g., 10{倍|ばい}).
The ratio of applicants to available positions, used for exams, jobs, and other competitive selections. A higher number means stiffer competition.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう}→望遠鏡：05483_bouenkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{倍率|ばいりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何倍|なんばい}→何倍：22969_nanbai⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is the magnification of this telescope?

examples.japanese: {倍率|ばいりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぼやける→ぼやける：16967_boyakeru⟧。
examples.english: When you increase the magnification, the image becomes blurry.

examples.japanese: {高|たか}{倍率|ばいりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}→顕微鏡：05482_kenbikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{細胞|さいぼう}→細胞：05030_saibou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}した→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I observed cells with a high-magnification microscope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{倍率|ばいりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧だった。
examples.english: The competitive ratio for this year's entrance exam was three to one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧{倍率|ばいりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Popular companies have extremely high application-to-hire ratios.

examples.japanese: {倍率|ばいりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧10⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some schools have competitive ratios exceeding ten to one.

notes:
USAGE:
In everyday Japanese, {倍率|ばいりつ} appears frequently in two very different contexts: optics and competition. Context makes the meaning clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倍率|ばいりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high magnification; high competition)
- {倍率|ばいりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to increase magnification)
- ⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{倍率|ばいりつ} (entrance exam competitive ratio)
- ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧{倍率|ばいりつ} (job openings-to-applicants ratio)

FORMS:
⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧ (times, fold) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate, ratio). The ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ suffix is productive in forming ratio/rate words: ⟦{確率|かくりつ}→確率：00159_kakuritsu⟧ (probability), ⟦{利率|りりつ}→利率：21159_riritsu⟧ (interest rate).
